verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a live, key-gated REST Cloud API with a published OpenAPI spec. It can programmatically launch and restart instances and inject workloads at launch via cloud-init, so an agent can provision and run work without the console. Teardown is covered only by the general 'create and manage' API language, not an explicit terminate endpoint quote. Monitoring evidence points to the console Usage page, and the CLI/MCP options in the pack are unofficial third-party tools, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: explicitly documented terminate endpoint, programmatic instance/GPU monitoring or status API, official CLI or MCP server, hands-on end-to-end corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can provision a GPU, monitor it, run a workload, and tear it down end to end through documented APIs, CLI, or MCP without a human in the console

citations.quote: You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
If you're launching your instance with the Lambda Cloud API, you can add launch-time configuration instructions using [cloud-init](https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
You can also restart instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
the instance-provisioning REST API is live and key-gated
